scripts.db:migrate: docker compose exec -T db psql -U geouser -d geo_platform -f /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/../migrations-run/001_init_schema.sql 2>/dev/null || docker compose exec -T db psql -U geouser -d geo_platform < database/migrations/001_init_schema.sql
scripts.db:seed: docker compose exec -T db psql -U geouser -d geo_platform < database/seeds/sources.sql && docker compose exec -T db psql -U geouser -d geo_platform < database/seeds/locations_hanoi.sql
scripts.docker:up: docker compose up -d --build db app crawler
scripts.crawl: docker compose run --rm crawler python -m scheduler.run_once
